body:
# Digital Accessibility

Our mission is to help organisations build digital environments that everyone can use. Ampera is a team of IAAP‑certified experts, including people with and without disabilities. We show what happens when deep expertise meets real‑world accessibility needs

Connect with us to know more

#### How We Work

### Our Accessibility Approach

- 1. Audit & AssessmentOur team conducts comprehensive testing for websites, mobile apps, software, and documents.
- 2. Remediation & ImplementationWe address the barriers, fix them, update and implement validated output into the existing system smoothly.
- 3. Ongoing Monitoring & SupportWe support evolving and improving your platform as your business grows and technology changes.

#### WHY CHOOSE US?

### Trusted Accessibility Experts

Ampera has an inclusive workplace alongside people with disabilities (PWDs), so we know how accessibility plays a vital role in reaching broad audiences. Your business should be reachable by everyone.

Our experts check your site for barriers, fix them and ensure everyone can use it, following all the latest global accessibility standards. We monitor your software and increase reach, enhance engagement, and strengthen trust.

We understand that ensuring accessibility isn’t just a business requirement; it is to promote inclusivity and improve user experiences.

Enable accessibility

#### Key Benefits

We boost your business and global presence by building inclusive experiences that follow all major accessibility guidelines.

Compliance Made Easy

Align with global standards and guidelines

Inclusive User Experience

Gain trust and more traffic with inclusive digital platforms

Expand Your Reach

Make your digital platforms accessible for everyone.

#### FAQs

How do you prevent accessibility regressions after updates?

We do continuous monitoring. All updates are checked for accessibility using AI and manual testing and meet compliance. We ensure the new update does not affect the existing features.

#### Contact Us

### Let’s Build an Accessible Future Together

Every person should be your client; every client is Valuable. Partner with Ampera to build digital experiences everyone can use and reach customers with confidence.
